description: Baseline: Average SELECT/INSERT ratio is 4.33:1. Multiple followers (8:1 ratio) and fast polling scenarios show worst case. Target is <2:1.

Add delay(0) after emitting chunks to break tight polling loop. Single follower ratio improved to 2.0-2.33:1, but multi-follower (3 followers) still at 7.5:1. Need to address concurrent follower polling.
